Slow away. Recovered & raced Worse than midfield on inside (5L from lead) early . Stayed Worse than midfield Two Wide midrace & 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed to quicken Four Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & outsprinted in last 250m. # Never Likely

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Shade slow away. Not pushed early & raced keenly behind Mid Field 3 Wide With Cover (5L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed out Five Wide @ 500m. Chasing Seven Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 8W @ 300m & struggled in last 200m. # Struggled from turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away well. Pushed fwd & shared lead 3 Wide early . Back 1 length midrace & tightened & back 2 Lengths @ 600m. Pushed to quicken 3 Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & outsprinted in last 150m. # Found trouble.
Jumped Ok Settled Down 9th fence over-racing 6 Lengths 800m 10th held up 7 Lengths home turn last Under Pressure no run on Straight # back/poor run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Overraced throughout the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Rolled fwd & raced keenly 2nd 3 Wide No Cover (1/2L from lead) early . Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed along 3 Wide @ 500m. Pressured Four Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Weakened Four Wide in straight. # Worked & weakened
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned rider stated that he had the option to obtain a prominent position if the horse began well. He said after jumping well from a wide barrier he rode the horse forward however the gelding was left racing wide and without cover where it travelled keenly.
